No new occurrence this run.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict stays ok.
